voice.name: Open Sector - Heavy Assimilator
voice.description: Enormous, slow machine voice of a giant legged alien war machine of a cyborg hive: very deep sub-bass layered voice, as if several huge synthetic voices speak at once an octave apart, grinding metallic overtones and a rumbling engine-like drone beneath every word, cold, emotionless and inevitable, each word heavy and deliberate with long pauses.
voice.sample: Heavy assimilator awake. We walk, and the ground breaks beneath us. Your armor is matter. Your walls are matter. All of it returns to the collective. We do not hurry. We arrive.

fire.prompt: Distant, powerful blast of a huge sci-fi plasma disruptor cannon firing in an open field: a deep heavy electric plasma boom with a sharp sizzling energy discharge crackling on top and a long rolling echo, energy weapon, no gunpowder, no music, no voice

move.prompt: Large four-legged alien war machine stalking forward: quick heavy hydraulic legs stepping in rhythm, metallic thuds on dirt, servo whine and pneumatic hiss, close, no music, no voice

burrow.prompt: Large four-legged machine burrowing into the ground: metal legs digging fast into earth, grinding and scraping through soil and stones, servo whine and hydraulic hiss, loose dirt pouring and sliding down over the hull as it sinks under, close, outdoors, no music, no voice

unburrow.prompt: Large legged machine erupting up out of the ground: a sudden heavy upward burst of earth, dirt and rocks bursting into the air and raining down, metal legs scraping free, a hydraulic hiss and servo surge, close, outdoors, no music, no voice

die.prompt: Large legged alien war machine destroyed: a heavy metal explosion with crackling electric arcs discharging, a dying synthetic drone winding down in pitch, steel legs buckling and the body crashing to the ground, medium distance outdoors, no music, no voice
